title: LV
description:
Single-family house of T4 typology, developed entirely on a single level, located in a residential context in Alenquer.

The volumetric composition is defined by a clear and restrained parallelepiped form, carefully carved at its extremities. The introduction of wooden slatted elements at the ends of the volume brings lightness to the overall composition and softens its presence, reinforcing the domestic scale of the architecture.

The decision to adopt a compact floor plan stems from the intention to achieve a rigorous and efficient spatial organization, where each space is clearly defined and directly articulated.

At the level of the parapets, the composition articulates distinct volumes, each expressed through a specific color and texture. This material and chromatic strategy introduces subtle variation into the reading of the building, enriching its formal expression while preserving the unity of the whole.
